violation_type.title: Primary Caregiver Annual Training- Remaining training topics (26 TAC §747.1309(f))
violation_type.short_title: Primary Caregiver Annual Training- Remaining training topics
violation_type.typical_finding: Annual tranings were reviewed during today's inspection.  7 clock hours are needed to meet the required 30 clock hours of annual training.

finding_variants.text: Annual tranings were reviewed during today's inspection.  7 clock hours are needed to meet the required 30 clock hours of annual training.

The caregiver did not receive training in the following topics for the September 2020-September 2021 training year:  1. Emergency preparedness  2. Communicable diseases and immunizations  3. Administering medications  4. Food allergies  5. Understanding building and physical premises safety  6. Handling, storing and disposing of hazardous materials.
The following trainings were unavailable at the time of inspection;  food allergies, hazardous material and medication
1 out of 1 records reviewed is  missing 3 required training hours under this minimum standards.

Documentation showing the following training topics have been completed was not available for review during inspection:    - Handling, Storing and Disposing of Hazardous Materials  - Understanding and Responding to Food Allergies  - Understanding and Preventing the Spread of Communicable Diseases

The primary caregiver did not have the required trainings available for review for the following topics;  SIDS  Food allergy  Administer medication and  Handling, storing and disposing of hazardous material
